title: Trial record (F154-FR-018, F154-FR-019; data-model.md D3)
description: One trial: a run of a fixture set with only one switch changed, read with `specstride report` (F154-FR-018). PROPOSAL of spec 154. Written by `scripts/trial.mjs` under `specs/154-concurrency-and-parallelism/trials/<switch>.json` as a ledger kind `parallel` (row 184, proposed). Its pass mark is safety, the table `trial-pass-mark-table.json` (TRI-1…TRI-3): no breach invariant of F142-FR-071 fails, every test of a rule passes, and the sets of exit codes, stop reasons and run states are subsets. Its rows are reported without a pass mark: the share of groups kept, refusals per reason, cost with every pass counted. The trial shows safety, not a default: a switch turns on only when the owner reads this record and writes the register row (CQ-154-15 A). The first case of the trial of P2 and P3 is the replay of feature 153's 28 groups (F154-FR-019).

switch.description: The one switch the trial changes, e.g. `loop.parallel.noRepeat`.

fixtureSet.description: The fixture set run twice, e.g. `fixtures-154.json`.

firstCase.description: The replay of feature 153's 28 groups (F154-FR-019): kept 0 of 28 on record.

arms.description: Two arms: the fixture set with the switch off, and with only that switch changed. Stub agents, the same seed of session ids.

switchValue.description: False for the arm with the switch off; true for the arm with only that switch changed.

seed.description: The seed of session ids, the same in both arms.

ruleTests.description: Every test of a rule, with its outcome (TRI-2).

breachInvariantsFailed.description: The breach invariants of F142-FR-071 that failed; empty for TRI-1.

closedSets.description: TRI-3: each set with the switch on must be a subset of the set with it off. No exit code, stop reason or run state is added (F154-FR-002).

pass.description: Pass = TRI-1 and TRI-2 and TRI-3 (`trial-pass-mark-table.json`). A pass mark of safety only: it is not a default.

rowsWithoutPassMark.description: The rows the trial reports without a pass mark (F154-FR-018).

groupsKept.description: The numerator of the share of groups kept: groupsKept over groupsTotal.

reason.description: A refusal reason of a delta (row 63), `group-check` proposed, or an admission check of a group (row 61), `repeat` and `dependency` proposed.

costWithEveryPassCounted.description: Cost of the arm with every pass counted, the set-aside units included.
